about_the_game:
A Oriental Arcade Feast

Imagine this: with a gentle push of your finger, gold coins cascade down like a waterfall, accompanied by crisp, clinking sounds, as wealth accumulates amidst a rich Chinese ambiance. This coin-pusher game, built with the Unity3D engine, perfectly blends classic arcade fun with oriental aesthetics, offering an immersive casual experience.

The game's visuals feature backgrounds of ​​classical lattice windows, red lanterns, and traditional courtyards​​, creating a festive atmosphere. The Unity3D technology provides realistic physics for coin dropping and collisions, making every push full of anticipation

The core gameplay is simple and easy to pick up: by precisely controlling the push angle and force, players aim to push coins or prizes into the collection chute, experiencing the thrill of toppling a carefully built wall of coins. The game innovatively introduces a ​​combo system and a lucky wheel​​ for multiple rewards, alongside collecting cute pets and unlocking new maps for sustained enjoyment.

Players start with 50 free coins and can accumulate wealth even offline

. Embark on this oriental coin-pushing journey now and let the delightful sounds accompany your path to prosperity
